name: Ghoul
traits: Medium undead with no Constitution score, a 30-ft. land speed, and darkvision 60 ft. Speaks Common. Proficient with simple weapons. Favored class Ghoul.

At 1st level, the monster class grants a primary bite for 1d4 plus Strength modifier, +1 natural armor, turn resistance +2, and one feat. At 2nd, the ghoul gains two 1d3 claws as secondary attacks and +2 to Dexterity and Charisma.

At 2nd level, a bite or claw hit can paralyze the target for 1 minute. Fortitude DC is 10 + half class Hit Dice + Charisma modifier. Elves are immune. At 4th level the bite becomes 1d6 and paralysis lasts 1d6+2 minutes.

Spawn creation begins at 5th level. A humanoid killed by the ghoul rises as a 5th-level ghoul after 1d4 days unless protection from evil is cast on the body first. The creator controls up to twice its Hit Dice in spawn and loses control of the oldest spawn when it exceeds that limit.

name: Green Hag
traits: Medium aquatic monstrous humanoid that breathes air and water. Starts with +2 Intelligence and +2 Wisdom. Land and swim speeds are both 30 ft. Darkvision 90 ft. +8 racial bonus to special Swim checks, take 10 under pressure, and run while swimming straight. Speaks Common and Giant and mimics nearby animal calls.
The class grants simple weapon proficiency and two primary 1d3 claws at 1st level. Claws become 1d4 at 8th. It grants feats at levels 1, 3, 7 and 13. Favored class Green Hag.

Change self, dancing lights, ghost sound, and pass without trace start at one use each per day and become at will at 3rd level. Invisibility, tongues, and water breathing start at one use each per day at 3rd level and become at will at 6th. Caster level is class Hit Dice.

Weakness first appears at 4th level. A melee touch hit can deal 1d4 Strength damage, Fortitude DC 10 + half class HD + Charisma modifier negates. The damage becomes 1d6 at 7th and 2d4 at 10th. Spell resistance equals 4 + class level starting at 7th.

name: Griffon
traits: Magical beast, Medium until class level 10. Starts at −6 Intelligence and −2 Charisma with a 30-ft. land speed. Darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, +4 racial Jump, and +4 racial Spot in daylight. Understands Common but cannot speak. Favored class Griffon.
At class level 1, gains a primary 1d6 bite and scent out to 10 ft. Two secondary 1d4 claws and 50-ft. flight with average maneuverability begin at 3rd level.
At 4th level, pounce permits a full attack after a charge. At 6th level, pounce can add two hind-leg rake attacks, each dealing 1d6 plus half Strength modifier at the normal claw attack bonus.
Scent reaches 20 ft. at 5th level and 30 ft. at 9th. Flight improves to 80 ft. at 9th. Large size and 10-ft. face arrive at 10th. The class grants no weapon, armor, or shield proficiency.

name: Hamatula
traits: Medium outsider with the evil and lawful subtypes, +2 Strength, +2 Wisdom, and a 30-ft. land speed. Immune to fire and poison and sees in natural or magical darkness. Speaks Celestial, Draconic, and Infernal. Proficient with simple and martial weapons. Favored class Hamatula.
Two primary claws start at 1d4 plus Strength modifier, become 1d6 at 3rd level, and 2d4 at 11th. Telepathy starts at 2nd with a range of 100 ft. and requires the other creature to know a language.

The table grants an attempt to summon lemures at 3rd level, improved grab at 6th, and impale at 7th. Impale requires a successful grapple check against a held opponent and deals 3d4 piercing plus one and a half times the Strength bonus. Fear on a hit uses a Will save of 10 + half class HD + Charisma modifier, with a one-day lockout for that hamatula regardless of the result.

Lesser spell-like powers start at 2nd level at one use per day each, rise to three at 5th, and become at will at 8th. The second list starts at 7th, rises to three at 10th, and becomes at will at 13th. Greater powers and spell resistance start at 9th. Caster level is class Hit Dice, spell save DC 10 + spell level + Charisma modifier, and spell resistance when gained is 9 + class level.

name: Magmin
traits: Small fire elemental with −2 Strength, +2 Dexterity, −2 Intelligence, 30-ft. speed and darkvision 60 ft. Speaks Ignan. Favored class Magmin. The class grants no weapon, armor, or shield proficiency.

Burning touch is a natural weapon dealing fire damage only. Its die rises from 1d4 at level 1 to 1d6 at level 3 and 1d8 at level 5. A metal weapon wielded by the magmin adds half the touch fire damage to its usual damage.

Fiery aura begins at 2nd level. Its radius and fire damage rise from 5 ft. and 1 damage to 10 ft. and 1d3 at 4th level, then 30 ft. and 1d6 at 6th. Fortitude DC is 10 + half class Hit Dice + Constitution modifier. At 2nd level a metal weapon that strikes the magmin may melt if it fails the same save.

At 3rd level, burning touch also ignites clothes or heats armor unless the target passes a Reflex save at that DC. The ongoing fire equals the touch die for 1d4+2 rounds after the last successful touch. The class also grants DR 5/+1 at 3rd.
The 3.0 fire subtype is immune to fire damage. Its saves against cold attacks take a −10 penalty, or it takes double damage when a cold attack offers no save.
